Container.Name: Vestigo
Container.Overview:
Vestigo Media Tracker: self-hosted playtime and session tracker for Steam, Xbox and PlayStation (plus anything you push via the API).
Platforms only report lifetime playtime, so Vestigo snapshots it on a schedule (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly or every X days/hours) and turns the difference into play sessions. Live presence (what you're playing right now) pins sessions to exact start/end times and triggers a sync as soon as you stop playing.
Your existing hours are never dumped onto import day: they are dated from first/last played dates, launch counts, achievement unlock times, release dates and account age, and shown as estimated history.
Works out of the box: add the container, open the WebUI, connect an account. Stats, heatmaps, year in review, duplicate handling across platforms, CSV/JSON import, REST API, webhooks, error log and diagnostics included.
Already running PlayTracker? Keep its container: it updates to Vestigo by itself. To switch to this template anyway, stop and remove the old container first and point Data at its folder.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface and API. Change the host side if 7720 is taken.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database (vestigo.db) and optional log file. Coming from PlayTracker? Use its folder (e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/playtracker): its playtracker.db is used in place.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional password for the UI and API (can also be set in Settings). Leave empty for open LAN access.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: debug | info | warn | error. Warnings and errors are always kept in the in-app error log (System page).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody)

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: Set to true when served over HTTPS (reverse proxy)

Config.Name: CORS origin
Config.Description: Allow browser API calls from another origin (e.g. a dashboard)
